itemList.description: Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Fabricated Main frame for housing refractory bricks & other allied equipments, Furnace main door, Furnace supporting frame, Main door lifting mechanism by manual & motor operating system, Counter weight, Ash removing door & Ash tray, Ash removing tools, Other accessories, front Stainless Steel sheet covering. Top, side & back covered with MS sheet. Materials used for main furnace: MS angle size 50 x 50 x 5mm, MS sheet 2mm x 5mm, MS Flats - 100 x 5mm, 100 x 16mm, 50 x 10 mm, 40 x 5mm. Stainless Steel sheet - 1.5mm sheet, Square rod - 20 x 20 mm, MS pipe - 75 x 25 mm, Bolts & Nuts of suitable size, Hinges, Self-threading screws. Main shaft - 50mm dia, Sprockets, chain, Gearbox, Motor & other accessories to complete the furnace - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Refractory bricks IS8 & IS6 of standard temperature withstanding capacity upto 1200 Deg Celsius, Insulating bricks for furnace chamber including secondary chamber, Fresh air & smoke exhaust trench consisting of standard bricks, Hot & Cold zone bricks, Insulating bricks, Ceramic blanket, Covering different size of slabs, Body resting bricks, Arch bricks & other shaped bricks with refractory binding agent, fireclay, Firecrate super mortar, Insulated door with layers of ceramic blanket(sizes: 600 x 25mm of 64 kg/cum & 124 kg/cum)
[Refractory bricks sizes : 230 x 115 x 75 mm, Slabs : 600 x 300 x 150 mm & 600 x 300 x 75 mm, Arch bricks : 230 x 115 x 70/75 mm, Insulation bricks : 230 x 115 x 75 mm, Body resting slab size: 600 x 300 x 150 mm] - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Heating coils made out of Nichrome wire 80/20 of gauge 8 with terminal rods. Vertically mountable Coils each of 3.5kW capacity housed in ceramic insulation 310 grade Stainless steel pipe mounted vertically on either side of the main chamber with suitable mounting arrangement. Coils shall be connected in star through electrolytic copper bus bar of each group of 4 Nos of coil - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of fabricated body charging trolley made out of rigid frame work mounted on a solid moving system, hydraulically operated, Lifting, Pushing system with all necessary required equipments with complete operation from control desk - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of stabdard Motor operating contactors with relay, indicating lamps, push buttons, current transformer, Voltmeter, Ammeter, Temperature controller, safety equipments & switches, isolators near equipment, MCCB, non-corrosive heat resistant control & power cables including wiring, complete panel board, termination to connected equipment of furnace as per Electrical Inspectorate guidelines, specialized Earthing as per IS standard at the equipment end - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of 1HP, 3 phase, 415V, 2880 rpm Water pump connected to Stainless Steel Water tank below Scrubber unit including necessary pipeline for inlet & outlet of 2 " MS pipe - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Fresh air blower consisting of 1 HP blower made of MS sheet & MS pipe, connecting duct controlled by butterfly valves from blower to furnace for fresh air flow to inside furnace - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of SS water scrubber unit with vertical venture arrangement with water inlet/outlet connections from furnace duct to chimney exhaust fan, water circulating system. Scrubber mounted on a platform made of MS angle/channel support and sheets. SS sheet pipe connecting from smoke duct to scrubber/exhaust fan/ 270 x 270 x 2 mm , Chimney connecting pipe 230 x 230mm x 2mm from Blower outlet. Scrubber & pipeline SS 304 2mm thick sheet and Flanges MS 8mm thick - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Exhaust blower made of SS 304, 2mm sheet fabricated with body, belt driven blower fan, 50mm dia shaft & bearing, 230 x 270mm inlet & 230mm outlet pipe, 5/7.5 HP 3 Phase motor to drive the blower mounted on MS frame work - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work

Supply, Erection & Commissioning of Fabricated Self-supporting chimney with the following particulars.
Top Diameter: 300mm, Bottom Diameter: 700mm, Total height: 30 Meters,
Bottom plate: 1200 x 1200 x 25mm,
Bottom Flange: 1200 mm dia x 16 mm,
Vertical Ribs: 12mm thickness, 
Chimney flanges: 10mm thick.- 8 No's, Gusset plate: 10m thick.
Conical pipe - Conical segment of 12 Meter with 700mm dia to 300mm dia 8mm thickness
Straight pipe - Straight segment of 18 Meter with 300mm dia 5mm thickness
Inspection door: 400 x 500mm, 10mm thick covering plate
Foundation bolts: 40 mm dia, 2000/1500mm long with nuts & washers.
HOOD: 700mm x 3.15mm thick with nuts & bolts for chimney.
Ladder: MS Angle 40x40x5 mm, footsteps:MS Angle 40x40x5 mm, upto chimney platform
Chimney ladder support: 40 x 40 x 5mm angle, hand rail -25NB MS pipe.
Support - 25 NB MS pipe, platform for pollution checkpoint.
Frame - 40 x 40 x 6mm angle, Bottom stiffeners - 600mm long, 
straight supports on platform - 600mm long, 
M S plate - 1600mm dia, 5mm thick.
Safety measures consisting of Aviation lamps, lightning arrester, earthing strips & other allied materials - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Electrostatic Precipitator(ESP) to remove fine particles as per the Pollution Control Board Norms - in complete manner including all lead & lift as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of the work
